The silent killer: state, identity and channels

takeaways: Custom-built Microsoft 365 agents usually fail on identity, shared conversation state and channel semantics, not on the model.
The Microsoft 365 Agents SDK standardises sign-in and act-as-user identity, turn state, the Activity protocol and streaming while staying model agnostic.
Registering through Azure Bot Service and wiring Purview, DLP and audit logs from day one lets agents inherit enterprise governance instead of reinventing it.
hook: Custom AI agents for Microsoft 365 break under real users, lose context across nodes and fail security review. This episode is for developers and architects building agents for Teams, Copilot and web chat. Learn what the Microsoft 365 Agents SDK gives you and a step-by-step blueprint to ship a secure, stateful multi-channel agent.
